title: Localizations are weakly etale ring maps
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M\subseteq A$ a multiplicative subset ($1\in M$ and $st\in M$ for $s,t\in M$). Let $B=M^{-1}A$ be the ring of fractions $a/s$, with $a/s=b/t$ when $u(at-bs)=0$ for some $u\in M$. Then the canonical ring map $A\to B$ is weakly etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]: $B$ is flat as an $A$-module and is flat as a module over $B\otimes_A B$ via multiplication.
